question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enormous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'Tiny'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enormous"** means extremely large in size, quantity, or extent. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example: **The building was so enormous that it could be seen from miles away.
 
 
 
• **"Tiny" **refers to something that is very small in size. (छोटा)
 
 
• **Example: **The newborn kitten was so tiny that it could fit in the palm of my hand.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Enormous' **is **'Tiny'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tiny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inapposite** (अप्रासंगिक): Not suitable or appropriate in the context.

 
 
• **Example:** His comments were inapposite to the discussion at hand.
 
 
 
• **Irrelevant** (असंगत): Not connected with or relevant to something.
 
 
• **Example: **The information she provided was irrelevant to the case.
 
 
 
• **Gigantic** (विशालकाय): Extremely large.
 
 
• **Example:** The gigantic statue towered over the park.
